title: Can Shrimp See More Colors? 🦐 #Shorts
description:
No — despite having 12–16 color receptors, the mantis shrimp actually distinguishes FEWER colors than you. Scientists at the University of Queensland found it fails to tell colors apart closer than 25 nanometers, while humans see differences of a single nanometer.
